name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # 变更范围检测：以 .arc-flow/flow.toml 的 scope 规则为单一事实来源
  # （cargo flow scope --base <ref>），把检测到的组件集下发给各验证 job。
  # 只改文档/单端代码的提交不再触发全量验证。
  scope:
    name: Detect change scope
    runs-on: self-hosted
    timeout-minutes: 10
    outputs:
      components: ${{ steps.detect.outputs.components }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
      - name: Detect verification scope
        id: detect
        env:
          PR_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PUSH_BEFORE: ${{ github.event.before }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          BASE_REF=""
          if [ -n "${PR_BASE:-}" ]; then
            BASE_REF="$PR_BASE"
          elif [ -n "${PUSH_BEFORE:-}" ] && [ "$PUSH_BEFORE" != "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]; then
            BASE_REF="$PUSH_BEFORE"
          fi
          if [ -n "$BASE_REF" ] && git cat-file -e "$BASE_REF^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
            cargo flow scope --base "$BASE_REF" --json > scope-output.json
          else
            cargo flow scope --all --json > scope-output.json
          fi
          COMPONENTS="$(node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("scope-output.json","utf8"));process.stdout.write(d.components.join(","))')"
          echo "components=$COMPONENTS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "scope: $COMPONENTS"
      - name: Upload scope report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: scope-report
          path: codex-audit-pipeline/.codex/reports/scope.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14

  quality:
    name: Quality gate
    needs: scope
    # contains() 为子串匹配；当前组件名 workflow/backend/frontend 两两不成子串，安全。
    if: ${{ contains(needs.scope.outputs.components, 'workflow') }}
    runs-on: self-hosted
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json
      - name: Install frontend dependencies
        working-directory: frontend
        run: npm ci
      - name: Verify development workflow
        run: cargo flow verify --components workflow
      - name: Upload quality reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: quality-reports
          path: codex-audit-pipeline/.codex/reports/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14

  backend:
    name: Backend verification
    needs: scope
    if: ${{ contains(needs.scope.outputs.components, 'backend') }}
    runs-on: self-hosted
    timeout-minutes: 20
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: arc_admin_test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: arc_admin_test
          POSTGRES_DB: arc_admin_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U arc_admin_test -d arc_admin_test"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Run backend checks and tests
        env:
          TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://arc_admin_test:arc_admin_test@127.0.0.1:5432/arc_admin_test
        run: cargo flow verify --components backend
      - name: Upload backend report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: backend-report
          path: codex-audit-pipeline/.codex/reports/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14

  frontend:
    name: Frontend verification
    needs: scope
    if: ${{ contains(needs.scope.outputs.components, 'frontend') }}
    runs-on: self-hosted
    timeout-minutes: 20
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: arc_admin_test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: arc_admin_test
          POSTGRES_DB: arc_admin_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U arc_admin_test -d arc_admin_test"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json
      - name: Install frontend dependencies
        working-directory: frontend
        run: npm ci
      - name: Prepare Doctor prerequisites
        run: |
          cp backend/.env.example backend/.env
          git config core.hooksPath codex-audit-pipeline/hooks
          mkdir -p codex-audit-pipeline/.codex/reports
      - name: Verify CI environment
        env:
          TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://arc_admin_test:arc_admin_test@127.0.0.1:5432/arc_admin_test
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          cargo flow doctor --strict --json | tee codex-audit-pipeline/.codex/reports/doctor.json
      - name: Audit production dependencies
        working-directory: frontend
        run: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
      - name: Install Playwright browser
        working-directory: frontend
        # CentOS runner dependencies are provisioned on the runner host.
        run: npx playwright install chromium
      - name: Run frontend checks and tests
        env:
          TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://arc_admin_test:arc_admin_test@127.0.0.1:5432/arc_admin_test
        run: cargo flow verify --components frontend
      - name: Upload frontend report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: frontend-report
          path: codex-audit-pipeline/.codex/reports/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 14

  dependency-review:
    name: Dependency review
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.repository.private == false
    runs-on: self-hosted
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/dependency-review-action@v5
        with:
          fail-on-severity: moderate
